title: Access and Public Affairs playbook (OpenSky example)
status: OpenSky-authored example; not a Sanofi document
rules: Validate the barrier with local partners before choosing an intervention.
Use existing delivery and stakeholder relationships for short in-season activity.
Assign owners across Public Affairs, Medical, Market Access and providers.
Distinguish execution from outcome, and agree baseline and comparison before starting.
Capture data-through dates and known parallel campaigns.
Escalate longer-term structural barriers into the out-of-season planning cycle.

title: Commercial and marketing playbook (OpenSky example)
status: OpenSky-authored example; not a Sanofi document
rules: Separate total market uptake, enhanced-category adoption and Efluelda share.
Check availability and dispensing before inferring weak demand.
Evaluate Sanofi franchise movement including Vaxigrip.
Keep medical/policy interpretation consistent with equivalent HAS positioning.
Do not interpret shipments as administration or reimbursement values as net revenue.
Use prospective hypotheses and team review rather than automated recommendations.
